notes.title: Bardbarian Halloween Update
notes.notes: Halloween has infected Bardbarian's town more than anticipated in this content update.  Even the enemy hordes are joining in.  Use your lute and loot skills to  unlock a new character for your team. Have fun, and hope you enjoy our 2spooky update.
